WHEREAS, I have, in terms of paragraph (1) of Article 43 and paragraph (1)(a) of Article 46 of the Constitution of theDemocratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, determined the number of Ministers of the Cabinet of Ministers and the Ministriesand the assignment of subjects and functions and Departments, Public Corporations and Statutory Institutions to the saidMinisters;

It is now hereby notified that the subjects and functions and Departments, Public Corporations & StatutoryInstitutions in the charge of various Ministers shall be as set out in the Schedule given below, from the date of thisNotification.
